notes: No genuine Bestsellers-type PLP found on goodearth.in. Access: direct HTTP fetch (no WAF, robots.txt allows general crawling, no Claude-specific disallow); confirmed with Playwright rendering. Checked: (1) sitemap.xml -> sitemap-header.xml (100+ nav/category URLs) and sitemap-footer.xml -> no Bestsellers/Best-Sellers/Top-Sellers/Popular URL anywhere. (2) Rendered /sitemap page (full site index, 138 links) -> same, no such entry. (3) Rendered homepage mega-menu structure (HOME/APPAREL/GIFTING/OUR WORLD) via the sitemap XML/page equivalents -> no Bestsellers nav item or homepage promo tile. (4) Guessed URL shapes /bestsellers and /best-sellers rendered via Playwright: both fall through to the SPA's default homepage content (identical title/body to a deliberately nonexistent control URL /nonexistent-random-xyz123), proving these are not real routes. (5) Site's own product-search API (https://pb.goodearth.in/myapi/search/) was tested with search/keyword/query params for 'bestseller' and other terms - the param is silently ignored and always returns the full catalog count (884), confirmed with a nonsense control query returning the identical count; this is a false-absence-prone search layer per prior project experience, so it was NOT relied on as absence proof. (6) Pulled the site's complete categoryShop taxonomy facet list from the search API (all 18 real category nodes: Dining, Drinkware & Bar, Decor, Home Textiles, Cushion Covers, Ancient Rituals, Bath & Fragrance, Kids, Jaipur Rose, Edit, Isla, Hosting Edit, Saanjh, Sustain Woman, Jewellery, Shop By Recipient, Shop By Occasion, Shop By Material) - none is a Bestsellers-type merchandising node; the closest are named 'collections' (Jaipur Rose/Edit/Isla/Hosting Edit) which are cross-category capsules, not popularity-based listings. Concluded: no Bestsellers PLP exists on this site.
